data.narrative:
Together AI is a Series C artificial intelligence and software company seeking valuation guidance. The analysis draws on a comp universe of nine private peers and one public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR), with particular focus on three same-sector, same-stage companies: Figure AI ($39.0B), Skild AI ($14.0B), and Crusoe Energy ($10.0B).

Two valuation methods triangulate on the target. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement to Together AI's last post-money valuation of $8.3B, yielding $14.1B. Peer-median analysis across the three same-stage AI & Software comparables produces a median of $14.0B, with a range spanning $10.0B to $39.0B. The wide peer dispersion reflects heterogeneity in business model maturity and market positioning within the frontier AI sector.

The two methods converge closely, supporting a valuation range of $11.9B to $16.2B, with a median point of $14.1B. This range sits near the high end of the peer minimum but well below the peer maximum, reflecting Together AI's competitive position without assuming it commands the premium multiple of Figure AI. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory, unit economics validation at scale, and the durability of current frontier AI market valuations. The tight methodological convergence provides moderate confidence in the central estimate.
